summary.en: Because of Kogoro's love for horses, he takes Ran and Conan to an OK corral ranch in Kisarazu, a city from Chiba Prefecture. One of their prize winning horses gets spooked and they all go running after her. They reach the horse and Conan finds blood on her horseshoe. They then find the farrier, the one who shoes the horses, murdered. Location: OK Corral Ranch Victim: Motoo Sugiyama Cause of death: Heavy blow to head Suspects: Madam Leap
